Certainly lad, although im no historian so forgive my somewhat brief and cursory explanation of a subject that can fill many books with the depths of its complexity.

Now as I understand it, divination has always existed in many forms and the true origins of the Tarot are debatable but from what I understand a proto-form manifested (in the guise of playing cards) in Europe around the beginnings of the Renaissance and said cards had prior origins with the Marmalukes.

The cards ( known as trionfi and later as tarocchi or tarock) were used from the mid-15th century onwards, in various parts of Europe to play games such as the Italian tarocchini, the French tarot and an Austrian game called Königrufen. The primary purpose of these card decks seemed to be geared towards amusement/the playing of games.

Sometime in the 18th century, playing card/tarot packs began to be used in parallel, for divination purposes (in the form of tarotology and cartomancy) and, later, specialist decks were developed for such occult purposes (Most famously the Rider-Waite)

The frog occultist, "Etteilla" (irl power word - Jean-Baptiste Alliette) was supposedly the first to issue a tarot deck specifically designed for occult/divination purposes sometime around 1789. He interpreted and superimposed the hermetic knowledge contained within The Egyptian Book of Thoth into his deck. His treatise, "Cour théorique et pratique du Livre du Thot" introduces the concept of the "Major" and "Minor Arcana", as well as the introduction of the four elements and astrology too.

The system began to permeate the European consciousness & just over a century later, the English poet and occult scholar Arthur Edward Waite (who was heavily influenced by another frog occultist, Eliphas Levi) refined the concept into his own, comprehensive deck and accompanying dedicated system, giving us the Rider-Waite deck we are all familiar with, which was notable for being one of the first tarot decks to illustrate all 78 cards fully, rather than just the 22 major arcana cards. (IIRC Golden Dawn member Pamela Colman Smith illustrated the cards for Waite.)

Since then, the concept has expanded and many different decks, methods and systems now exist (for example, mexican merchant and pretentious avant garde film director Alexandro Jodorowski recently resurrected & published the forgotten/incomplete Marseille deck)

As divinatory systems go, I like the Tarot because it is so comprehensive and, provided one is well versed in its rules & symbolism, it leaves little margin for error or misinterpretation. Of the many forms of divinatory practise available, I find the Tarot the most comprehensive and in depth while at the same time maintaining a user friendly interface that is akin to riding a bike (I once tried to get to grips with another divination system known as the "Pauline Arte" and could I get to grips with it? Could I fuck. Found it overly complicated and convoluted had little success) Personal use and the results observed thereof, have convinced me there is merit to the system and I find it resonates with me so much as to be my preferred tool for divinatory practise. I suppose it bears some similarities to the I-Ching; its ancient far-eastern counterpart.

"And For My Tea" is a unique documentary that uses footage captured by Lee Hoyland who runs the YouTube Channel 'big man lee', previously known as 'leeiscool1'

This documentary provides a rare glimpse into the diet of a UK male in 2016. Lee provides us with an introduction to each meal,. he chooses to present these from a top-down perspective. Each shot is consistently poorly lit, often bathed in an unbalanced abd over saturated yellow light. These colours represent the heavily processed nature of each food, mass produced, full of chemicals and colouring agents, lacking in natural substance. Take notice how each meal is often 'slapped onto the plate'; there is no sense of care or even respect for the food. Notice too how a simple sandwich is often presented squashed, ripped, or torn. Take note too of how there is not one single 'healthy' meal documented.

This documentary aims to bring question to our own individual diets. It leaves us wondering, how often do we consistently eat processed, mass produced, greasy, cheap and unhealthy foods? What would our own 'FOR MY TEA' documentary be like? And furthermore, does this inspire you to consider your own diet?

Although there are some lighthearted elements within, dig further beneath the surface and there are some genuine life lessons to be learnt from this film.

From a personal perspective, I feel there is a lot relatable here. Parts of the film become repetitive, just like the 'daily grind of life'. The same thing, over and over and over again. The routine, the predictability of it all. Where I found frustration in this, Lee seems either ignorant to such a perspective, or he is quite simply, happy and content with this life. The simple pleasure of filming one's food placed before them. The dedication Lee displays in his choice to consistently vlog his food throughout the day. There is no nothing false here. No pretence, no lies, no attempt to cover the truth. Here, Lee became a true documentarian, and we must praise him for this.

Therefore this documentary film becomes something else, a contemporary piece of art.

The busting station's speaker system crackled into life and a tinny robotic voice announced…

"The 6:15 to Balamorey from London Waterloo is about depart from platform 14A"

Wee Colin stepped on board the locomotive. The train carriage's suspension baulked and the entire car dipped several inches as he hefted his corpulent frame on board. His greedy scottish eyes surveyed the scene and to his relief, there was still some seating space left within the carriage. Most of the table-seats were occupied, one by a large paralytic bald & heavily tattooed man in a vomit stained "Norf FC" football shirt (surrounded by empty cans and other detritus), another by a couple of elderly women discussing a crossword puzzle. A nun of the Carmelite Order was sat alone at another seat. Wews briefly entertained the idea of sitting next to her but her but the appearance pf her habit disconcerted him somewhat & he muttered to himself…

"She looks like a fuckin' penguin and i'm no sittin' next ta nae penguin, help me boab!"

A pretty girl in her mid 20's sat alone near the end of the car, scrolling through her smartphone, headphones in her ears and upon seeing this delectable feminine form alone and potentially, yearning for his enlightened company, wews finally decided upon his resting spot for the journey. Thoughts of the journey ahead circled in his mind and he envisioned enrapturing her with psuedointellectual wank and regailing her with tales of his internet fame and his very high standing in the ranks of the organisation known as the "alt right". His acerbic wit and new Oscar Wilde style hair would surely win the heart of this demure filly and he envisioned her running through wheatfields in a white dress, her fingers trailing through the barley as he followed behind. Was it possible to fall in love at first sight? His heart began to pound in his chest.

"Och mind if ah sit here hen?"

..asked wews but, to his discombobulation, the girl did not reply, failing even to look up or acknowledge his presence. He took her silence as tacit consent and heaved his bloated form onto the seat facing her, causing the springs inside to groan and creak, displaced by his ample form. Startled by the sudden weight displacement and waft of bodily odour (one she found reminiscent of week old socks & stale haggis) the girl looked up and smiled nervously. Wews smiled back - a grotesque rictus-grin of cracked yellow, popcorn like teeth, each one misaligned and caked in plaque. The girls smile vanished and wews, nerves suddenly jangling decided to introduce himself.

"Eeerrr.. hullo there lassie. Erm, mah name is W-woes. M-millenial Woes. Nice tae meet ya. Youse proabably heard o' me. I'm a big yin shot in the alt right so ah am, bit of a celebrity and that. Ahm very big on the internet ya ken!"

He chuckled nervously and thrust a grubby swollen hand towards her. The nicotine stained fingers were stunted and chubby and the nails caked with god knows what. The girl wretched visibly and the colour drained from her face. Without a word she got up and walked to the other end of the carriage before finally settling down next to the unconscious, vomit stained Norf FC fan and his collection of empty lager tins nervously looking back at wews a few times before settling back down.

Wews let out a dejected sigh and his mind began to tick over in a torturous inner monologue

"Fa fuck sake. First that Lucy Broon bitch blows me oot, noo this…Ah think im ganna have yet another existential crisis so ah am"

Tears began to stream down his chubby cheeks and despite some vain attempts to remain stoic & resolute, wews sobbed quietly to himself for the rest of the journey.

It was a relief to arrive back in Scoatlan, as the train pulled into Balamorey station but wews also felt a sting of trepidation too. The noodle armed antifa cucks who doxed him were here, in the same town, as were the muckraking journalists who had made his life such a misery the year before. Wews cast his misgivings aside and waddled into one of the waiting taxis. Instructing the driver of his destination, he set off toward one of the few places he felt safe & secure - his mams hoose….

(cont…)

(2)

Upon ariving at the familial home, woes rung the doorbell. The front door opened and he was met with the familiar sight of his mam - a three foot six scotch/italian goblin in a pink hairnet, who perpetually wore a grubby apron.

"Hullo son. Hoo was London? Did ye have a gud time wi yer internet friends?"

"I dinnae want tae talk aboot it"

…replied a dejected wews, slouching apathetically, with his mop of greasy curtains covering his tear streaked face.

"Whats wrong son? Did seeing all the broon people upset ya again? Dinnae be shy noo, ye can tell yer ma so ye can"

"Nah mam, its nae that, well not that kind of broon anyway. Its Lucy. Lucy Broon."

"Oh that wee journalist lassie ye were going to see? Hoo did that turn oot?"

"Not well mam. Suffice ta say she wouldnae gobble doon mah sweaty scotch eggs"

Upon disclosing this most troubling revelation to his beloved mater, emotion again overcame wee wews and he burst into a fit of uncontrollable sobbing, befouling his underpants in the process.

"Och, never mind son. Yer too gud fir a bottle-blond trollop like that anyway. Come on in and ma will git ya cleaned up & make yer favorite dinner - deep fried mars bars and spaghetti in iron bru sauce. Noo come inside and give yer ma a hug"

Wews crossed the threshold and embraced his jockwopgoblin mater, finding solace within her udder-like bosom. Finally his sobbing abated.

Wews sat down to dinner and greedily devoured the meal his mother had cooked up for him, forgoing the use of utensils entirely in lieu of his fingers.

"Ah wish youse would use yer knife and fork son. Ya make such a mess so ya do"

…opined mother woes.

"Git tae fuck ma - ya ken this saves us money on the washing up liquid"

…snapped an irritated woes, flecks of chewed spagetti and mars bar spraying from his full mouth in the process. Upon swallowing, he allowed himself a small grin, satisfied at yet another act of scottish frugality. Like any good scot he was tighter than a gnats chuff & proud of it to boot.

"Oh I forgot ta tell ye son. Yer we friend was roond this mornin' lookin for yae. That commander knightmarez boy. Nice wee lad him. I telt him yee'd be back tonight."

Suddenly woes spirits lifted and he was filled with a fresh vigour. An idea of unbridled genius entered his mind and within a flash he whipped out his mobile phone and, via the medium of text message, informed his trusty friend that he was now home and, consequently he was to attend him forthwith. He was met with the reassuring vibration and the reply relayed to him the information that knightmarez would be there within the hour. The rictus grin returned…

"Youse look a bit happier son!"

…said mater wews, an audible sense of relief in her tone.

"That ah am mam aye. Knightmarez is coming roond. Is it okay if ah take him up to mah room to….erm…. show him mah nintendo?"

"Aye son. But NAY smearing poo on the walls this time else ill have ta call oot Dr McValium again. And crivvens, we dinnae want that now do we…och the neighbours were gossiping fa weeks so they were."

Woes energies were rekindled. The Lucy Brown dejection still stang, a wound he felt from which he would never fully recover but second best was better than nothing. Soon, an unsuspecting knightmarez would arrive, only to be met with the raw passion of years of pent up NEET incel sexual frustration. An outlet was in sight. If his tumescent caber was to be denied the embrace of Lucy Brown's moist love canal that night, then knightmarez's rectal cavity would have to do. After all…..

"Any hole is a goal"

..he reasoned with himself as he mentally and physically prepared himself for a night of baccanalian buggery in the spirit of the ancient Greeks. It hadn't been the first time and nor would it be the last, that knighmarez derriere would have to stand substitute for wew's latest failed female conquest. Willing or not, knightmarez was to meet his preordained destiny this night and get turked by a jockwop….

Hrēþmōnaþ

To our Anglo-Saxon/AngelSeaxe forebears the month of ‘March’ was known as Hrēþmōnaþ, as such that is what it is called by us today in Angelcynn Fyrnsida.

Hrēþmōnaþ means the month of Hrēþ(e). However, the month is also known as Rhedmonath – a Latinisation of Hrêðmonaþ, and it is also known as Hlýdmónaþ.

Hrēþe is an English Gyden (Goddess) as noted by Bede, and she gave her name to this month of ours.

On the one hand Hrēþ really means “quick / swift / rough”, while Hrêð means “glory / fame / triumph / honour” with Hrêðe meaning “fierce / cruel / savage”.

Whereas Hlýd(a)mónaþ means the month of noisy winds and storms. This holds true to this day with Hrēþmōnaþ bearing this kind of weather.

Linguistics is a vital tool in reconstructing Heathendom and linking ourselves back to our indigenous Angelseaxe belief. These meanings show that the Gyden Hrēþe is linked to, and probably commands, strong and noisy winds, she is fierce and savage, and given that her month sees the ending of winter, she is thought of as victory/triumph over the harshest part of the year which wrought great hardship to our old English forebears. There was likely a tale of her defeating the forces of (Wuldor’s) winter, with her powerful natural strength which ushered in a shiny summer.

That our Angelseaxe forebears knew only winter and summer as seasons is well known, and within this the end stages of Hrēþmōnaþ see the ushering in of summer. Within this month is Lencten – which means the ‘lengthening’ of the days, as winter passes and summer comes, the days lengthen and become fuller with Sunne and other sun/light Gods become visibly more powerful and noticeable in Middangeard. Likewise it is around this time that much loved Gods such as Bealdor and Ingui return from their Godly homes and Great Halls to Middangeard.

Our Heathen forebears held blót to Hrēþe at this time and thanked her. Beowulf’s grandfather Hrēðel, is also likely named after her.

Hlýda is likely another name for Hrēþe which both show the divine nature of the Gyden and which characterise this time of year. Interestingly, the name Hludana – one of The Mothers and likely the mother of Thunor - likely comes from the Germanic meaning for “loud / famous” a direct association with the meaning of Hlýda. She appears in the Icelandic Voluspa as Hloþyn. Despite this not being a settled matter, it is very tempting to link Hrēþe / Hlýda with Hludana / Hloþyn, a fittingly powerful Gyden for the mother of Thunor, who is protector of the every-man.

In this Hrēþmōnaþ, we Angelcynn Fyrnsideras as Leodish (tribalist) Heathens celebrate and give thanks to our English settlement in Britain from Germania, for Leodish Fyrnsideras are as tied to the land as we are to our kith and kin.

In doing so, we hold Engla Tocyma (‘the coming of the English’) blót and symbel and thereafter feast. Hrēþmōnaþ was chosen by Angelwita Leofric to hold Engla Tocyma, because it is in this month in which the brighter summer days are brought forth by Hrēþe, which is a fitting metaphor for our folk’s arrival and settlement in Britain.

During Engla Tocyma our Founding Fathers, among them Hengest and Horsa are hailed and given thanks to. Ochta and Ebissa were twin brothers who led the Angelseaxe settlement of Britain in the 5thC CE. At some point before their fara (adventure) to Britain the brothers were given/took on the names of Hengest and Horsa (which mean stallion and Horseman), as nicknames/epithets, and these names are likely the individual names of the divine brothers otherwise known as the Alcis. The Alcis must have been the patrons of Hengest and Horsa, and they must have been thought to possess much of the characteristics that the Alcis have.

Moreover, the 9 Worthy Frecan which include: Angul, Offa of Angel, Hengest and Horsa, Æsc/Oisc, Cerdic, Penda, Sigehere and Arwald are also hailed as archetypes for English Heathens.

All the Gods of the Ese and Wæne are likewise beseeched and given thanks to, so to the Mothers and Wyrd Sisters are hailed, as of course our forebears are also given thanks to.

The howling winds of Hrēþmōnaþ remind us of the stormy seas that our Germanic forebears crossed in the settlement of Britain from Germania (at sundry different times from the late BCE up to the middle Angelseaxe era).

Faran (‘adventurism’), one of our Athelwunan (‘noble-habits’) is suitably reflected on at this time, for this was one of the chief Athelwunan which brought our forebears to these shores.

Hail Hrēþe!

Hail the Lencten!

Hail the brothers!

Hail the English!
